court.name: Madurai Bench of Madras High Court

summary: In June 2013, one person was arrested in Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu for the aggravated penetrative assault on a child. The charges also include house trespass and criminal intimidation. A weapon was used or a threat was made. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused was convicted and sentenced to 10 years in prison, and later acquitted on appeal. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Aggravated penetrative assault on a child — Ramanathapuram (2013) — acquitted on appeal
